extDescription.message: Adds your children's Novakid lessons to Google Calendar, e.g. the shared Family calendar. Not affiliated with Novakid.

hintOpen.message: Open the Novakid schedule page while logged in – your children's lessons are read automatically.

lastError.message: Last attempt to read the schedule failed: $ERR$

noFamily.message: No Family calendar found – pick a calendar from the list.

sessionExpired.message: Google session expired – click Connect Google again.

icsDone.message: Exported $N$ lessons. Import them at calendar.google.com → Settings → Import and export.

forgotten.message: Stored lessons, children's names and Google sign-in were removed from this browser.

disclaimer.message: Unofficial tool, not affiliated with or endorsed by Novakid.
